record_type_quote:
The original study relied on data from the 2008, 2010, and 2012
      AmericasBarometer national surveys of Argentina and Mexico. The data used in the
      replication are from the same source, and for the same countries, but from the 2014,
      2016/17, and 2018/19 surveys.

targets.authors: Hiskey, J. T., & Moseley, M. W.
targets.title: Severed Linkages: Distorted Accountability in Uneven Regimes.
targets.evidence_quote:
Data-analytic replication attempt to evaluate 5 claims from
                          Hiskey_CompPolitStu_2018_AYQG
targets.outcome_quote:
The effect is not statistically
significant at the 5% level (p = 0.804), two-tailed test. Consequently, this claim was
not replicated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Claim evaluations explicitly say claims 1, 4 and 5 were not replicated and claims 6 and 7 were replicated. These are five claims from one original paper.

reasoning: The assigned OSF identifier resolves directly to the final SCORE report by Esteban Méndez Chacón, an assigned contributor. Its reference dates the Hiskey and Moseley original 2018 rather than 2017. It uses different AmericasBarometer survey waves, hence replication despite secondary-data terminology.
